channel.title: Kenya Connectivity Map blog
channel.description: Data notes on internet and electricity access across Kenya's 47 counties.

item.title: The most and least connected counties in Kenya
item.description: Nairobi scores 96.8 out of 100 on my county connectivity ranking and Turkana scores 10.7. See the full spread and what drives it.

item.title: Seven Kenyan counties have electricity access below 20%
item.description: 7 Kenyan counties sit under 20% electricity access in the 2019 census data: Turkana, West Pokot, Wajir, Mandera, Samburu, Marsabit and Tana River. Here is how the rest compare.

item.title: The data, formula and limits behind the Kenya Connectivity Map
item.description: The data sources, the composite score formula and the known limits behind the Kenya Connectivity Map, written by the person who built it.

item.title: Internet use in Kenya by county
item.description: Nairobi has 64.7% internet use and West Pokot has 9.1%. Full ranking of all 47 Kenyan counties from the 2022 survey.

item.title: Cell tower density in Kenya by county
item.description: Nairobi has 4,916 cell towers per 100 km² and Wajir has 0.3. Full ranking of all 47 Kenyan counties from OpenCelliD data.

item.title: Mobile internet speed in Kenya by county
item.description: Nairobi averages 62.1 Mbps on mobile and West Pokot averages 16.0. Ranking of Kenyan counties by Q1 2026 Ookla download speed.

item.title: Digital Literacy Programme devices in Kenyan schools by county
item.description: 21,649 of 21,772 primary schools have Digital Literacy Programme devices installed. Samburu sits lowest at 76.7%. County by county table.

item.title: Unemployment rate in Kenya by county, 2019 census
item.description: Garissa has the highest unemployment rate at 40.6% and Nyandarua the lowest at 3.0%. All 47 Kenyan counties from the 2019 census.
